# Desert Kids Dental

> > A Las Vegas pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Sandra Thompson offering comprehensive children's dentistry services including preventive care, restorative treatments, emergency dentistry, and advanced technologies like Solea Laser and Silver Diamine Fluoride.

Desert Kids Dental specializes in pediatric dentistry across multiple Las Vegas locations (Skye Canyon, Centennial Hills, Providence). The practice is accredited by the American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry and American Board of Pediatric Dentistry, providing evidence-based care for infants, children, and teens with a focus on anxiety-free experiences and modern treatment options.

## Core Services

- [Preventive Pediatric Dentist Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/preventive-dentistry): Preventive dentistry services including cleanings, exams, sealants, and cavity prevention for children.
- [Pediatric Restorative Dentist Near Me](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry services including composite fillings and pediatric dental crowns for children.
- [Pediatric Dental Fillings for Cavities](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dental-fillings): Composite resin dental fillings for cavity treatment and repair in children.
- [Pediatric Dental Crowns Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/stainless-steel-crowns): Stainless steel and zirconia crowns for children's teeth restoration and damage repair.
- [Space Maintenance for Children](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/space-maintenance): Space maintainers for children with premature tooth loss using stainless steel and acrylic.

## Advanced & Specialized Treatments

- [Pediatric Sedation Dentist Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/sedation-dentistry): Pediatric sedation dentistry with nitrous oxide for anxious children and stress-free visits.
- [Las Vegas Emergency Pediatric Dentist](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/dental-emergencies): Emergency pediatric dentistry with same-day appointments for urgent dental injuries.
- [Las Vegas Pediatric Root Canal](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/pulpotomies): Pediatric pulpotomy and root canal treatment for tooth decay and emergency dental care.
- [Pediatric Tooth Extraction Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/extractions): Stress-free pediatric tooth extraction services for children in Las Vegas, Nevada.
- [Solea Laser Dentistry](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/solea-laser): Solea Laser technology for pain-free, noise-free, anesthesia-free dental procedures.
- [Silver Diamine Fluoride Treatment](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/silver-diamine-fluoride): Silver diamine fluoride treatment for non-invasive cavity prevention and dental decay.

## Specialized Pediatric Services

- [Las Vegas Frenectomy Dentist](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/frenectomies): Frenectomy and tongue tie removal for infants and children with breastfeeding support.
- [HealthyStart SDB Treatment for Kids](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/healthystart): HealthyStart treatment for sleep disordered breathing and airway expansion in children.
